selection_basis: Selected as an eligible unworked unit with an accessible detailed assessment. NOAA still identifies SEDAR 22 (2011), based on data through 2009, as the latest Gulf assessment. The report includes annual removals and indices, length frequencies, conditional age-at-length counts, biology and aggregate model outputs. Preserve native conditional compositions; do not infer catch-at-age or age-specific survey indices. The assessment was only partially accepted for status determinations, and its reported outputs are a cautious comparison reference.
